1.title: Pilot
1.synopsis: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

1.title: Cat's in the Bag...
1.synopsis: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

1.title: ...And the Bag's in the River
1.synopsis: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

1.title: Cancer Man
1.synopsis: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

1.title: Gray Matter
1.synopsis: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

1.title: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
1.synopsis: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

1.title: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
1.synopsis: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

2.title: Seven Thirty-Seven
2.synopsis: Walt and Jesse are vividly reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

2.title: Grilled
2.synopsis: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

2.title: Bit by a Dead Bee
2.synopsis: Walt and Jesse become short on cash when they try to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, the DEA has a lead that could them straight to Walt and Jesse.

2.title: Down
2.synopsis: Walt attempts to reconnect with his family, while Jesse struggles to rebuild his life.

2.title: Breakage
2.synopsis: Hank suffers from the aftermath of his encounter with Tuco. Meanwhile, Jesse hires a crew to get their product out on the streets.

2.title: Peekaboo
2.synopsis: Walt's secret is in jeopardy when Skyler thanks Gretchen for paying for his treatment.

2.title: Negro y Azul
2.synopsis: Jesse and Walt discuss expanding into new territories; Hank struggles to fit in; Skyler pursues a new job opportunity; Jesse gets to know his landlord.

2.title: Better Call Saul
2.synopsis: Walt and Jesse seek advice from a shady attorney when Badger gets in trouble with the law; the DEA believes they have caught up with "Heisenberg" ; Hank returns.

2.title: 4 Days Out
2.synopsis: Walt and his family wait for news after he undergoes a PET-CT scan. Walt follows Saul's advice; Jesse's relationship with Jane is put on hold when he and Walt head to the desert for a marathon of cooking.

2.title: Over
2.synopsis: Walt and Hank get into a heated argument at a party. Skyler opens up to her boss. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

2.title: Mandala
2.synopsis: As the end of her pregnancy finds Skyler conflicted about her feelings, a dealer's death forces Walt to look for somewhere to unload a load of meth.

2.title: Phoenix
2.synopsis: As Walt explores money laundering options, he and Jesse spar over the profits from their latest deal. Jesse and Jane clash with her father. Walt makes a fatal decision.

2.title: ABQ
2.synopsis: Skyler confronts Walt about his secrecy; Jesse falls apart; and Jane's grief-stricken father takes action that results in further tragedy.

3.title: No Más
3.synopsis: Walt faces a new threat, on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.

3.title: Caballo sin Nombre
3.synopsis: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.

3.title: I.F.T.
3.synopsis: Walt ignores Skyler's demands, furthering the rift between them and pushing her to break bad. Still suffering from panic and anxiety attacks, Hank crosses a line at work.

3.title: Green Light
3.synopsis: Walt loses control as he reacts to Skyler's news, endangering his job and relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank throws himself into his blue meth investigation. Jesse enacts a new plan.

3.title: Más
3.synopsis: Gus increases his efforts to lure Walt back into business, forcing a rift between Walt and Jesse. Skyler doubts her new relationship. Marie confides in Skyler about her concern for Hank's well-being.

3.title: Sunset
3.synopsis: Walt settles into his new surroundings; Walt, Jr. wants answers about his parents' relationship; Hank's investigation causes problems for Walt and Jesse.

3.title: One Minute
3.synopsis: Hank's increasing volatility forces a confrontation with Jesse and trouble at work. Skyler pressures Walt to make a deal. Gus' actions have severe consequences.

3.title: I See You
3.synopsis: The family waits for news about Hank. While Jesse covers at the lab, Walt attempts to placate Gus. After witnessing a disturbing outburst, Walt worries he and his family are in danger.

3.title: Kafkaesque
3.synopsis: As Hank's hospital bills stack up, Skyler hatches a plan. Walt and Gus come to a better understanding. Jesse, looking for more independence, pursues a new opportunity.

3.title: Fly
3.synopsis: Walt becomes obsessed with a contaminant in the lab and refuses to finish the cook until it is eliminated. A frustrated Jesse attempts to get Walt back on track.

3.title: Abiquiu
3.synopsis: Skyler gets involved with Walt's business. Hank struggles with his recovery. Jesse makes a startling discovery after meeting a girl at group therapy.

3.title: Half Measures
3.synopsis: Against Walt's advice, Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene and tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.

3.title: Full Measure
3.synopsis: With Jesse on the run and Mike in hot pursuit, Walt negotiates a bargain with Gus and concocts a disturbing plan to provide for his and Jesse's safety.

4.title: Box Cutter
4.synopsis: Walt and Jesse face the deadly consequences of their actions. Skyler deals with a puzzling disappearance, as Marie struggles to help Hank with his recovery.

4.title: Thirty-Eight Snub
4.synopsis: Walt attempts to form a new alliance as he plans his next move. Skyler pushes Walt towards a business opportunity, in hopes of protecting the family.

4.title: Open House
4.synopsis: Events spiral out of control at Jesse's place. Skyler reluctantly asks for Saul's help. Marie returns to an old pastime and a friend asks Hank for help.

4.title: Bullet Points
4.synopsis: The Cartel takes steps to gain the upper hand. Walt and Skyler share an embarrassing secret with the rest of the family. Jesse's activities draw unwanted attention.

4.title: Shotgun
4.synopsis: When Jesse goes missing, Walt fears the worst. Skyler has an unlikely reunion. Hank shares some bad news with Detective Tim Roberts.

4.title: Cornered
4.synopsis: Skyler makes an unsettling discovery. Walter, Jr. pushes his dad into a questionable purchase. Jesse offers Mike some unexpected help.

4.title: Problem Dog
4.synopsis: A frustrated Walt gambles on a risky new plan. Skyler's business venture hits a snag. Hank recruits Walter, Jr. for an unusual outing.

4.title: Hermanos
4.synopsis: Skyler develops an unusual solution to her money troubles. Hank enlists Walt to investigate a theory. Walt's impatience with Jesse grows.

4.title: Bug
4.synopsis: Skyler's past mistakes come back to haunt her. Gus takes action to thwart his rivals. Jesse seeks Walt's help, with mixed results.

4.title: Salud
4.synopsis: Walt's family worries when he doesn't turn up for Walter, Jr.'s 16th birthday. Jesse is forced to put his lab skills to the test without Mr. White's help.

4.title: Crawl Space
4.synopsis: Walt takes drastic action to protect his secret and Gus. Skyler's efforts to solve Ted's financial problems hit a wall.

4.title: End Times
4.synopsis: Hank pushes Gomez to pursue one last lead, while Walt struggles to protect the family. Jesse gets alarming news and rushes to meet with Mr. White.

4.title: Face Off
4.synopsis: Walt and Jesse team up to take on Gus. With Saul's help, Walt finds an unexpected ally.

5.title: Live Free or Die
5.synopsis: As Walt deals with the aftermath of the Casa Tranquila explosion, Hank works to wrap up his investigation of Gus' empire.

5.title: Madrigal
5.synopsis: Walt and Jesse pursue an unlikely business partner. The DEA filters through various leads in hopes of finding something.

5.title: Hazard Pay
5.synopsis: Walt and Jesse formulate a new business plan. Walt shares a secret with Marie.

5.title: Fifty-One
5.synopsis: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler contemplates her options, and an associate puts a crimp in Walt and Jesse's business strategy.

5.title: Dead Freight
5.synopsis: Walt's team gets creative to obtain the methylamine they need to continue their operation.

5.title: Buyout
5.synopsis: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

5.title: Say My Name
5.synopsis: Walt takes control of business matters; Mike deals with the consequences of his actions.

5.title: Gliding Over All
5.synopsis: Walt takes care of loose ends; Walt makes a dangerous decision.

5.title: Blood Money
5.synopsis: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

5.title: Buried
5.synopsis: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

5.title: Confessions
5.synopsis: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

5.title: Rabid Dog
5.synopsis: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

5.title: To'hajiilee
5.synopsis: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

5.title: Ozymandias
5.synopsis: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

5.title: Granite State
5.synopsis: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

5.title: Felina
5.synopsis: All bad things must come to an end.
